current_difficulty_reason: Dense linear Neumann traces alone cannot solve the quadratic shape-response constraints while keeping all remaining directions small. Section2 constructs paired time-separated trace targets so that the finite-dimensional quadratic response can be controlled, then closes the exact constraints through a Brouwer correction. The final approximate-control stage must preserve that nonlinear correction uniformly, which remains a substantive construction after standard heat and fixed-point foundations are allowed.
